forge_smith.text: Sheffield sits on five rivers: the Don, the Sheaf, the Porter, the Loxley and the Rivelin. Water wheels drove hammers and grindstones all over.
Benjamin Huntsman perfected crucible steel near here in the 1740s. He melted steel in clay pots until it was even all the way through.
Tap a good blade and it should ring. Tap a bad one and it goes thunk, and so does your reputation.

then.text: Forge is hot. Want to use the bench?

else.text: Mind the anvil, love. It's not moving, but your toes are.
A horseshoe for luck, forged on peat with an ammonite set in the crown. Points up, so the luck doesn't drain out.
Hang it over a creature and it'll take a knock it shouldn't survive. Once. Luck's not a bottomless pit.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. You can use my kitchen.
